label: Production and animal health
text: BI.O.A3.5 Production and animal health. The organism kept or grown for use: crop, livestock, aquaculture and forestry organisms. Husbandry claims state the conditions, the population and the measure; no universal yield is owned. Disorder, diagnosis and treatment of non-human animals are owned here. The drug substance and its residue in human food are owned by MD.O.A4.1 (uses MD.O.A4.1, MD.O.A4.4). The food molecule is CH; a food standard is W12. Plant form (root, shoot, meristem) sits across A3.1–A3.2 at the same level as animal form.

warrant.warrant: W3, W4, W12 (husbandry and diagnostic standards)
warrant.standard: Replicated field or herd trial with stated season, population and measure
warrant.defeaters: Site and season confounding; non-random herd selection
